title: Real public example: Marks & Spencer Copilot rollout

public_facts.fact: M&S announced it is buying 11,000 Microsoft 365 Copilot licences for every Store Manager and every Store Support Centre colleague. The announced rollout size is 11,000 colleagues.
M&S said the licence purchase is backed by an AI training and development programme to help colleagues adopt the tools.
M&S said Store Managers can use the tools for sales insights, meeting notes, shift rotas and handovers.
M&S lists 64,000 colleagues and 1,059 UK owned and franchise stores for the whole company. These are company totals, not the size of the Copilot rollout.

system_notes: The research date is 2026-11-19. The M&S announcement is from 2026-03-25, so it is background context and not a fresh buying signal.
Salesforce and Gong are not connected, so past contact, customer status and open deals are unknown.
No Multiverse win-rate history was used, so the fit score starts at 50.
